_comment: Smoke spec files per CI shard for two Playwright workers per shard, balanced on per-file durations measured in one local two-worker run on the production build (both shards sum to about 236 s; the seed project's serial files are 20 s in shard 1 and 61 s in shard 2, far below half of that). Playwright's own --shard splits by test count. CI timing differs from local, so CP4 re-measures. A new smoke spec must be added to one shard; smoke-shards.test.mjs fails otherwise.
